hero.subtitle: We use advanced AI to evaluate football talent objectively, breaking geographic barriers and creating equal opportunities for all.

about.description: OPENsport is an AI-powered scouting and training platform for football. We analyze player performance through phone camera video, deliver professional-grade metrics, and provide personalized training programs — making elite-level analysis accessible to every player, coach, and club.

ai.title: AI Scouting
ai.description: Upload a video from any phone camera. Our AI extracts pose data, evaluates technique, power, stability, and balance — delivering a full scouting report in under 60 seconds.

analytics.title: Performance Analytics
analytics.description: Track progress over time with detailed metrics across every kick. Compare scores, identify weaknesses, and see measurable improvement session by session.

training.title: Smart Training
training.description: Get personalized training recommendations based on your analysis results. Follow structured skill trees with video-guided exercises to level up your game.

impact.title: COMMUNITY IMPACT
impact.description: From grassroots football to elite academies, OPENsport's AI-powered platform helps you evaluate talent, unlock potential, and make smarter development decisions.

global.title: GLOBAL REACH
global.subtitle: Connecting football talent from every corner of the world.
global.description: No borders, no limits — players can be seen, evaluated, and discovered globally.

fairPlay.title: FAIR PLAY
fairPlay.subtitle: Objective, AI-driven analysis for every player.
fairPlay.description: Performance is measured by data, not reputation, location, or background.

equalAccess.title: EQUAL ACCESS
equalAccess.subtitle: Equal opportunities for every football player.
equalAccess.description: Upload a video, get professional analysis, and receive feedback regardless of resources or connections.

howItWorks.description: OPENsport products are designed to improve how football talent is discovered and developed. From player profiling and performance insights to talent visibility and structured development pathways, each product is built to bring clarity, objectivity, and structure into the football ecosystem.

step1.title: Sign Up
step1.description: Create an account and get instant access to the platform. Join thousands of players already improving their skills.

step2.title: Upload Your Video
step2.description: Upload a match or training video directly from your phone or computer. Our AI handles the rest.

step3.title: Get Analyzed
step3.description: Receive AI-powered performance analysis with detailed metrics, insights, and personalized feedback within 60 seconds.

step4.title: Improve & Connect
step4.description: Track your progress over time, follow personalized training plans, and connect with coaches and opportunities.

quote.text: Talent can be wasted if it is not guided properly. Development is about education, patience, and creating the right environment for young players to express themselves.
quote.author: Arsene Wenger
